name: 置中浮動頁首（四角圓角）＋標誌左、導覽置中、選單按鈕右，選單往下延伸成大面板
desc: 固定在畫面頂端、和上方及左右都有距離的浮動頁首，約一半畫面寬並置中。標誌在左、導覽連結置中、右側一顆選單按鈕；點選單按鈕後頁首本身往下延伸成同寬的大面板。手機版收成全螢幕選單。
prompt: 建立一個和畫面邊緣有距離的浮動頁首，固定在畫面頂端。頁首和上方、左右兩側都有距離，寬度約為畫面寬的一半並水平置中；四個角（左上、右上、左下、右下）都做圓角。標誌在左，導覽連結置中，功能區在右，所有元素在同一水平線上垂直置中；右側的功能區放一顆選單按鈕，旁邊可再放主要按鈕或圖示按鈕，沒有時省略。捲動時頁首一直停在原位，不隱藏、高度不變，疊在頁面內容上方。點選單按鈕後，頁首本身往下延伸成一個同寬的大面板，原本的頁首列留在面板頂端，選單按鈕變成關閉按鈕；面板內由上而下依序是：一列三欄並排的連結卡（方形圖片在上，下方一個文字連結，右側帶箭頭）；兩欄文字連結列表，每個連結右側帶箭頭，項目之間有分隔線；兩張並排的橫向卡片；最底下一列，左側一排小圖示連結，右側靠右放一段小字。面板內的連結卡、卡片列與最底下一列可省略，沒有內容時省略，其他元素的位置不變。
mobile: 頁首仍是浮動的，和上方、左右兩側都有距離，寬度改為接近整個畫面寬；四個角（左上、右上、左下、右下）仍做圓角。頁首上只留標誌在左、選單按鈕在右，導覽連結與功能區的其他元素收進選單面板。點選單按鈕後，展開蓋住整個畫面的選單面板，浮動頁首留在面板頂端，選單按鈕變成關閉按鈕；面板內的連結卡改成單欄直向排列，每一列左側是小方形圖片、中間是文字連結、右側帶箭頭；文字連結也改成單欄直向排列，右側帶箭頭；每一項之間都有分隔線；下方接原本的卡片與小圖示連結，面板內容超出畫面時可在面板內捲動。捲動時頁首一直停在原位的行為保留。

en.name: Centered floating header (all corners rounded) + logo left, navigation centered, menu button right, menu expands into a large panel
en.desc: A floating header fixed to the top of the viewport, inset from the top, left and right edges, about half the viewport width and centered. The logo is on the left, the navigation links centered and a menu button on the right; tapping the menu button extends the header itself downward into a large panel of the same width. On mobile the navigation moves into a full-screen menu.
en.prompt: Create a floating header inset from the viewport edges, fixed to the top of the viewport. The header is inset from the top, left and right edges, about half the viewport width and centered horizontally; all four corners (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right) are rounded. Place the logo on the left, the navigation links centered and the actions group on the right, all elements vertically centered on the same horizontal line; the actions group on the right holds a menu button, and you may optionally place a primary button or an icon button next to it; omit them when there is no content. While scrolling, the header always stays in place, never hides and keeps its height, sitting on top of the page content. Clicking the menu button extends the header itself downward into a large panel of the same width; the original header row stays at the top of the panel and the menu button turns into a close button. Inside the panel, from top to bottom: a row of three link cards side by side (a square image on top, a text link below it with an arrow on the right); a two-column list of text links, each with an arrow on the right and dividers between the items; two landscape cards side by side; and a bottom row with a row of small icon links on the left and a short piece of small text aligned right. The link cards, the card row and the bottom row inside the panel are optional; omit them when there is no content, without changing the position of the other elements.
en.mobile: The header stays floating, inset from the top, left and right edges, and its width becomes close to the full viewport width; all four corners (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right) remain rounded. Only the logo on the left and the menu button on the right stay in the header; the navigation links and the rest of the actions group move into the menu panel. Tapping the menu button opens a menu panel covering the entire viewport, with the floating header staying at the top of the panel and the menu button turning into a close button; the link cards in the panel become a single vertical column, each row with a small square image on the left, a text link in the middle and an arrow on the right; the text links also become a single vertical column with an arrow on the right; there is a divider between every item; the cards and small icon links follow below, and the panel scrolls on its own when its content is taller than the viewport. The header still stays in place while scrolling.
